questions.answer: Small (1-2 elements), typical case, aur edge (empty, duplicates, negative, all same, extreme values). Ye teen bucket bolo aur ek-ek chalao.
questions.explanation: Small + typical + edge.

questions.question: Interviewer solution me bug dikhata hai — kaise respond karoge?
questions.answer: Acknowledge karo, effect samjho (kaunse input par fail hoga), fix karo aur same test case add karo. Defensive argue karne se better hai calmly trace karna.
questions.explanation: Acknowledge → trace → fix → test.

questions.question: Undirected graph me cycle detect kaise karoge?
questions.answer: DFS with parent tracking (visited neighbor jo parent nahi hai → cycle) ya DSU me union fail hone par. Directed me 3-color/recursion-stack method chahiye.
questions.explanation: Parent/coloring ka farq.

questions.question: Interview me solution ke baad 'production me kya badloge' poocha jaaye to?
questions.answer: Input validation, error handling, logging/metrics, streaming for large input, parallelism, tests, aur config. Ye senior signal hai — chhota code se production code tak ka gap dikhao.
questions.explanation: Interview code ≠ production code.

questions.question: Approximate solution acceptable ho to kya karoge (exact NP-hard)?
questions.answer: Approach ke saath trade-off bolo: greedy/heuristic with guarantee ya randomization; accuracy vs latency batao aur eval/counterexample se justify karo. Exact solution ka cost bhi mention karo.
questions.explanation: Approximation + guarantee.

questions.question: Coding round ke end me invalid input par kya karna chahiye?
questions.answer: Explicitly bolo: raise/return error with clear message, aur validation boundary par karo; silent default mat rakho. Plus model kotlin-style contract assertions tests me.
questions.explanation: Fail fast + clear error.

questions.question: Interview me complexity improve nahi ho rahi — kya strategy bataoge?
questions.answer: Constraints se hint lo: n = 1e5 → O(n log n), n = 20 → exponential/bitmask, memory tight → streaming. Phir data structure ka choice (heap, monotonic stack, prefix sums) enumerate karo.
questions.explanation: Constraints se approach nikalo.

questions.question: Checkpoint: do-pointer pattern ke do prerequisites likho.
questions.answer: Sorted order ya monotonic window property, aur pointer movement se condition ka predictably badalna.
questions.explanation: Prerequisites yaad rakho.

questions.question: Checkpoint: sliding window ka template (4 lines) likho.
questions.answer: left = 0; for right in range(n): window add karo; while invalid: window se hatao, left += 1; best update karo.
questions.explanation: Window template.

questions.question: Checkpoint: BFS aur DFS ke use-cases alag kaise likho?
questions.answer: BFS: shortest path (unweighted), level order. DFS: connectivity, topological sort, backtracking, cycle detection. Dono O(V+E).
questions.explanation: BFS levels, DFS depth.

questions.question: Checkpoint: hash map ke teen use-case likho.
questions.answer: Frequency count, complement/bool lookup (two-sum), aur grouping by canonical key (anagrams).
questions.explanation: Hash ke teen kaam.

questions.question: Checkpoint: backtracking ke teen steps likho.
questions.answer: Choose (path me add) → recurse → unchoose (undo), plus pruning condition.
questions.explanation: Choose/recurse/unchoose.

questions.question: Checkpoint: DP likhne ka 4-step process likho.
questions.answer: State define → recurrence (transition) → base case → answer extraction (aur iteration order).
questions.explanation: State → transition → base → answer.

questions.question: Checkpoint: binary search ke do common bugs likho.
questions.answer: Infinite loop (lo/hi update galat) aur overflow (mid = (lo+hi)//2 Python me safe, C++ me lo + (hi-lo)/2).
questions.explanation: Binary search ke bugs.

questions.question: Checkpoint: linked list problems ke teen techniques likho.
questions.answer: Dummy head (insert/delete simplify), fast-slow pointers (cycle/middle), aur reversal in-place with prev/cur/next.
questions.explanation: Linked list toolkit.

questions.question: Checkpoint: tree traversal ke teen orders aur unka output rule likho.
questions.answer: Preorder (root, left, right), inorder (left, root, right — BST me sorted), postorder (left, right, root — cleanup/dependency).
questions.explanation: Traversal orders.

questions.question: Checkpoint: stack ke teen classic use-case likho.
questions.answer: Balanced parentheses, monotonic stack (next greater element), aur undo/DFS iterative implementation.
questions.explanation: Stack ke kaam.

questions.question: Checkpoint: heap se do kaam likho.
questions.answer: Top-K/streaming max-min, aur scheduled work/shortest job first (priority queue). heapq min-heap hai — max ke liye negative values.
questions.explanation: Heap ke kaam.

questions.question: Checkpoint: interval problems ka approach likho (3 steps).
questions.answer: Start par sort karo, sweep karke overlap/conflict nikalo, aur boundary inclusive/exclusive clearly define karo.
questions.explanation: Sort + sweep.

questions.question: Checkpoint: matrix problems ke do patterns likho.
questions.answer: Row/col traversal with direction arrays (BFS/DFS), aur in-place rotation/transpose (index mapping).
questions.explanation: Matrix patterns.

questions.question: Checkpoint: string building me performance ki teen baatein likho.
questions.answer: Loop me + se concat O(n^2) ho sakta hai — list + join use karo; sorted/immutable ops copies banate hain; aur slicing O(k).
questions.explanation: Join karo, concat mat karo.

questions.question: Checkpoint: graph representation ke do tarike aur choice?
questions.answer: Adjacency list (sparse, memory-efficient) vs matrix (dense, O(1) edge lookup). Sparse graphs me list default.
questions.explanation: List vs matrix.

questions.question: Checkpoint: recursion ka base case aur progress condition likho.
questions.answer: Base case termination deta hai aur har call input ko chhota karni chahiye, warna stack overflow/infinite recursion.
questions.explanation: Har call chhoti honi chahiye.

questions.question: Checkpoint: complexity bataate waqt teen cheezein explicitly bolo.
questions.answer: Time (worst case), space (extra memory), aur hidden operations (sorting/concat/hash).
questions.explanation: Time + space + hidden.

questions.question: Checkpoint: coding round ka 5-step process likho.
questions.answer: Clarify constraints → examples banao → brute force + complexity → optimize + verbalize → code → test edge cases.
questions.explanation: Interview process.

questions.question: Checkpoint: 'divide and conquer' ke do example likho.
questions.answer: Merge sort (split + merge) aur binary search (half discard); plus quickselect for Kth element.
questions.explanation: Divide and conquer examples.

questions.question: Checkpoint: O(1) space optimization ke teen tarike likho.
questions.answer: In-place swap/reversal, two-pointer/rolling variables, aur input ko hi structure banana (marking via sentinel).
questions.explanation: Space optimization ke tarike.

questions.question: Explain: Arrays ko basic level par explain karo aur ek AI/data use case batao.
questions.answer: Arrays: ordered collection pattern for indexed data. Example: scan/transform. Pitfall: wrong complexity.
questions.explanation: USE / IMPACT: core coding interview problems ke liye.

questions.question: Define: Hash maps ko basic level par explain karo aur ek AI/data use case batao.
questions.answer: Hash maps: key->value lookup structure with average O(1) lookup. Example: seen[n]=i. Pitfall: hashability/collision/space trade-off.
questions.explanation: USE / IMPACT: frequency, complement and indexing problems ke liye.

questions.question: Differentiate: Two pointers ko basic level par explain karo aur ek AI/data use case batao.
questions.answer: Two pointers: two indices move based on invariant. Example: l,r=0,n-1. Pitfall: moving wrong pointer breaks invariant.
questions.explanation: USE / IMPACT: sorted arrays, partitions, pair problems me.

questions.question: Predict: Sliding window ko basic level par explain karo aur ek AI/data use case batao.
questions.answer: Sliding window: maintain a contiguous range while expanding/shrinking. Example: while r<n: .... Pitfall: window invariant unclear.
questions.explanation: USE / IMPACT: subarray/substring constraints me.

questions.question: Identify: Stack ko basic level par explain karo aur ek AI/data use case batao.
questions.answer: Stack: LIFO structure. Example: append/pop. Pitfall: wrong end operations.
questions.explanation: USE / IMPACT: parsing, undo, monotonic stack me.

questions.question: Apply: Queue ko basic level par explain karo aur ek AI/data use case batao.
questions.answer: Queue: FIFO structure. Example: deque.append/popleft. Pitfall: list.pop(0) slow.
questions.explanation: USE / IMPACT: BFS, task processing and scheduling me.

questions.question: Compare: Binary search ko basic level par explain karo aur ek AI/data use case batao.
questions.answer: Binary search: search sorted/monotonic space by halving. Example: lo,hi while lo<=hi. Pitfall: off-by-one and wrong invariant.
questions.explanation: USE / IMPACT: O(log n) lookup/answer search me.

questions.question: Choose: Sorting ko basic level par explain karo aur ek AI/data use case batao.
questions.answer: Sorting: reorder data to enable simpler reasoning or output. Example: sorted(xs). Pitfall: O(n log n) baseline.
questions.explanation: USE / IMPACT: ranking and enabling two pointers/binary search me.

questions.question: Diagnose: Recursion ko basic level par explain karo aur ek AI/data use case batao.
questions.answer: Recursion: self-reference with base case. Example: dfs(node). Pitfall: stack depth.
questions.explanation: USE / IMPACT: tree/backtracking problems me.

questions.question: Justify: Backtracking ko basic level par explain karo aur ek AI/data use case batao.
questions.answer: Backtracking: build candidate, test constraint, undo choice. Example: choose -> recurse -> pop. Pitfall: missing undo.
questions.explanation: USE / IMPACT: combinatorial search me.

questions.question: Design: Linked list ko basic level par explain karo aur ek AI/data use case batao.
questions.answer: Linked list: nodes linked by pointers/references. Example: slow/fast. Pitfall: lost next pointer.
questions.explanation: USE / IMPACT: pointer manipulation problems me.

questions.question: Refactor: Trees/graphs ko basic level par explain karo aur ek AI/data use case batao.
questions.answer: Trees/graphs: hierarchical or network structures represented as nodes/edges. Example: adj list + BFS. Pitfall: visited handling.
questions.explanation: USE / IMPACT: DFS/BFS/path problems me.

questions.question: Test: Heap ko basic level par explain karo aur ek AI/data use case batao.
questions.answer: Heap: priority structure supporting min/max retrieval. Example: heapq.heappush. Pitfall: heap invariant/negation.
questions.explanation: USE / IMPACT: top-k/scheduling problems me.

questions.question: Explain: Greedy/DP ko intermediate level par explain karo aur ek AI/data use case batao.
questions.answer: Greedy/DP: greedy makes local choice under provable property; DP stores overlapping subproblem results. Example: interval scheduling / knapsack. Pitfall: using greedy without proof.
questions.explanation: USE / IMPACT: optimization problems me.
